audit2 QC1: Zephras Isle's story both sides take, open to every race in the repack's AllowableRaces and in Forever's client (raceMask, Efficient Games). The repack names only the Horde quest before 92517 (92514; the Alliance's 93461 opens it too, by RewardNextQuest and the client's nextQuestId) and before 93320 (92871; the Alliance's 92860 ends at the same NPC), so the export gave all 20 the Horde's races. The Alliance-only 92701 and 93835 follow 93927 and 93958. Not 93949, which follows the Horde-only 92579
